title: Potato Leek Soup
description: A silky, comforting soup of leeks and potatoes simmered in broth and blended smooth, with a little cream and chives on top.

image.alt: A bowl of creamy potato leek soup with chives

ingredients.prep: white and light green parts, halved, sliced and well washed
peeled and cut into {len 1 in} chunks

steps.text: Melt the butter in the pot over medium heat. Add the leeks and a pinch of the salt and cook, stirring often, until very soft but not browned, {time 10 min}. Add the garlic for {time 1 min}.
Add the potatoes, broth, thyme and salt. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer, partly covered, until the potatoes fall apart when pressed, {time 20-25 min}.

Blend until smooth with an immersion blender, keeping the blade under the surface. In a regular blender, work in batches with the jar no more than half full and the lid’s center cap open, covered with a folded towel.
Stir in the cream and warm through without boiling. Taste for salt, then serve topped with chives.

notes: Leeks hide grit between their layers. Slice them first, then swish the slices in a big bowl of water and lift them out, leaving the sand behind.
Freeze before adding the cream for the best texture; stir it in when reheating.
